en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a small European town with multi-story masonry houses along a road. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk on the sidewalk beside a fenced watercourse or dry riverbed. Trees line the right side, with hills in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Schmiedeberg in the Erzgebirge and the specific street as Altenberger Straße.
